t: Crime Scene Solvers: Shot In the While Sleeping (Richard Alessandri Case)
st: Shot In the While Sleeping (Richard Alessandri Case)
d: On the night of July 16, 2000, the life of Edwige Alessandri changed forever.  She made a frantic emergency call in the town of Carpentras. She recounted that some men burst into her room and shot her husband while he slept.

t: Crime Scene Solvers: Victims of a Sadist - Cyril Koskinas Case
st: Victims of a Sadist - Cyril Koskinas Case
d: On July 19th 2004, the naked and tied up body of a woman is recovered in the Ourcq canal in Fresnes-sur-Marne. The victim is impossible to identify.

t: Crime Scene Solvers: The Little Martyrship of A10: The Inass Touloub Affair
st: The Little Martyrship of A10: The Inass Touloub Affair
d: On August 11, 1987, the Orléans police discover the bruised corpse of a 4-year-old child behind a guardrail on the A10 motorway.

t: Crime Scene Solvers: Deadly Trap For the Interior Designer - Guy Georges Case
st: Deadly Trap For the Interior Designer - Guy Georges Case
d: On April 18th 2014, in Visé, Belgium, policemen are informed that gunshots had been fired on the street.

t: Crime Scene Solvers: Crime Scene Solvers: A Deadly Date On the Internet (Ciampi case)
st: Crime Scene Solvers: A Deadly Date On the Internet (Ciampi case)
d: Marina Ciampi, 52, is found dead at her home in Marseille. The victim is naked on her bed, a plastic bag over her head. But no trace of a break-in is detected.

t: Crime Scene Solvers: The Christophe Lejard Case
d: The lifeless body of Christophe Lejard is found by his son just metres from their home. The man was shot in the head as he was getting into his car to go to work. An execution, which at first glance doesn't square with the profile of a quiet family man.

t: Crime Scene Solvers: Murdered For a Fake Treasure - Troadec Case
st: Murdered For a Fake Treasure - Troadec Case
d: On March 28th 2013, the burnt body of Anne Barbot, 38 years old, is discovered in a forest of Maine-et-Loire.

t: Crime Scene Solvers: Stabed In Her Bed: The Maureen Jaquier Case
st: Stabed In Her Bed: The Maureen Jaquier Case
d: On February 27, 2015, in Toulouse, the parents of 19-year-old Maureen Jacquier discover their daughter stabbed several times in her bed.

t: Crime Scene Solvers: The Savage Murder of a Mother and her Daughter (Amato Case)
st: The Savage Murder of a Mother and her Daughter (Amato Case)
d: On March 31, 2003, firefighters were called to a fire in a housing estate of Meyrargues, near Aix-en-Provence. On site, they discovered a horrific scene: the tortured and charred bodies of a mother and her daughter, Chantal and Audrey D'Amato.

t: Crime Scene Solvers: The Priscillia Ciatti Case
d: The corpse of Priscillia Ciatti, 14, is discovered by the side of a field, a few hundred metres from her family home. The teenager has been stabbed sixty times with a knife and –an extra sordid detail – a devil mask is found next to her body.

t: Crime Scene Solvers: Crime Scene Solvers: Murder in Le Grand Bornand (Flactif case)
st: Crime Scene Solvers: Murder in Le Grand Bornand (Flactif case)
d: Xavier Flactif, his partner Graziella and their three children suddenly disappear. For several days, mystery reigns.

t: Crime Scene Solvers: A Fatal Student Night (Stéphane Kameugne Case)
st: A Fatal Student Night (Stéphane Kameugne Case)
d: On December 24, 2008, the body of Stéphane Kameugne was fished out from a canal in Châlons-en-Champagne. The young man had been missing for two weeks and no one had seen him since the evening of his graduation ceremony from his engineering school

t: Crime Scene Solvers: The Key to the Enigma (Farid Ouzzane Case)
st: The Key to the Enigma (Farid Ouzzane Case)
d: On July 13, 2011, two boaters retrieved a suitcase that was floating in the bay of Lorient. Inside, they discovered the tied up corpse of a man. In order to identify this unknown man, whose face was unrecognizable.

t: Crime Scene Solvers: Four Lovers For One Crime: The Joël Deprez Affair
st: Four Lovers For One Crime: The Joël Deprez Affair
d: On February 5, 2000, two hunters discover a charred body on the banks of the Oise.

t: Crime Scene Solvers: The Willy Pomonti Case
d: Willy Pomonti, a retired architect, is found savagely murdered in his opulent villa in La Celle-Saint-Cloud, near Paris. It soon becomes clear that the man has been tortured prior to death.

t: Crime Scene Solvers: The Disappeared Of Nancy: The Julie Martin Affair
st: The Disappeared Of Nancy: The Julie Martin Affair
d: On June 30, 2014, in Nancy, the police are called to the home of Julie Martin, a 34-year-old nurse.
